title: Choose the Next Design Step
description: You have agreed on a notification service's requirements and interfaces. You have not yet explained how an accepted notification reaches a recipient. What is the most useful next step?

options.text: Choose a sharding algorithm before drawing any request flow.
options.explanation: Sharding addresses a particular bottleneck; you first need a complete baseline to know what needs scaling.

options.text: Trace acceptance, durable storage, processing and delivery in a working baseline.
options.explanation: A complete baseline demonstrates that the system meets its core requirements and exposes meaningful places for deep dives.

options.text: List every possible product feature to avoid missing anything.
options.explanation: The agreed scope should guide the design. Expanding it indiscriminately can prevent you from completing the core flow.

options.text: Calculate several storage totals even if none affects a decision.
options.explanation: Estimates are most useful when they determine a design choice, rather than as an isolated arithmetic exercise.
